author: ramblenation
quote: Story is abhorrent clownery Lucia is unbearable for the majority of this game. Frames drop so bad it makes the game so choppy and causes so much input delay mind you this is offline. GTA+ is a disgusting tactic a monthly service for a story mode game is insane. Driving in the game is horrible movement is horrible shooting is horrible. Such a lackluster game for all the hype and expectations.
